name: Wicked Paradise
source:
You take control of a young man who struggles to find a place in the world and doesn't know what lies before him. Discover people stories around you and your inevitable consecration into a world of crime.

Build relationships with them, knowing what people do and like. Your choices may or may not get you what you desire.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/vegastudio]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你控制了一个年轻人，他努力在世界上寻找一席之地，但不知道面前有什么。发现你周围的人的故事，以及你不可避免地陷入犯罪世界的故事。

与他们建立关系，了解人们的行为和喜好。你的选择可能会也可能不会让你得到你想要的。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/vegastudio]Patreon[/url]]
